tools.description:
Add a box centered at absolute object-local XYZ mm before instance transforms.

Affects all instances. Dimensions are positive XYZ mm. Supports regional
outer_wall_speed, inner_wall_speed, sparse_infill_speed, top_surface_speed
and internal_solid_infill_speed overrides as explicit arrays (e.g. [20]).
Re-slice after editing.
tools.name: add_modifier

tools.description: Add an empty plate to the working project.
tools.name: add_plate

tools.description: Edit working settings and force a fresh official native slice of the new revision.
tools.name: apply_and_slice

tools.description:
Arrange a plate with the native engine; 0 reorganizes all unlocked plates.

All-plate arrangement persists new plate counts and memberships.
A single-plate arrangement must fit that plate; overflow fails atomically.
tools.name: arrange_plate

tools.description: Orient selected/explicit plate objects; 0 selects all unlocked plates.
tools.name: auto_orient

tools.description: Remove the specified object from the working copy; preserves the input project.
tools.name: delete_object

tools.description:
Remove a working plate, parking its objects off-bed; retain at least one plate.

Geometry is preserved. Use move_object_to_plate to restore parked objects.
tools.name: delete_plate

tools.description: Delete an artifact draft only; cannot remove installed/canonical presets.
tools.name: delete_preset

tools.description: Describe a setting from the Snapmaker source catalog, including schema version.
tools.name: describe_setting

tools.description: Duplicate a complete object while preserving its component meshes and painting.
tools.name: duplicate_object

tools.description: Edit an artifact draft only. Installed/canonical presets remain read-only.
tools.name: edit_preset

tools.description:
Apply several edits atomically, each with an operation name and its arguments.

Supports set_config, set_object_config, add_modifier, duplicate/delete/transform_object,
add/delete_plate, move_object_to_plate, arrange_plate, auto_orient,
set_height_range, set_layer_height and reset_layer_height. Failure leaves
the current revision unchanged; every successful edit needs a fresh slice.
tools.name: edit_project

tools.description:
Report exact engine identity and optionally check upstream main.

New commits produce an update/rebuild notice. Never downloads, compiles,
switches or replaces the native engine.
tools.name: engine_status

tools.description: Read saved project settings (optionally selected keys), with secrets redacted.
tools.name: get_config

tools.description: Resolve a named preset's inheritance with hashes/provenance; redact credentials.
tools.name: get_preset_config

tools.description: Describe the working project, selected plate, objects and revision.
tools.name: get_status

tools.description: List stable root object IDs, parts, instance ordinals and transforms.
tools.name: list_objects

tools.description: List 1-based plates and their object/instance memberships.
tools.name: list_plates

tools.description: List declared read-only preset sources and working drafts; no global writes.
tools.name: list_presets

tools.description:
Load a complete saved 3MF into a private, versioned editing workspace.

Returns project_id, revision sha256 and working path. The input and
installed presets are read-only. Use project_id for the editing tools.
tools.name: load_model

tools.description: Move an object's instances to a 1-based plate, preserving their local offsets.
tools.name: move_object_to_plate

tools.description:
Recover a preserved original for a known generated G-code hash.

This does not reconstruct a mesh from G-code. Unknown/ambiguous sources
fail explicitly; recovered source bytes are checked against their hash.
tools.name: recover_3mf

tools.description: Rename an artifact draft only; cannot rename installed/canonical presets.
tools.name: rename_preset

tools.description: Save current working settings as an artifact draft, never over an installed preset.
tools.name: save_preset

tools.description: Search Snapmaker setting names, labels and descriptions.
tools.name: search_settings

tools.description: Select the default target for subsequent editing and slice_project calls.
tools.name: select_plate

tools.description:
Apply a resolved preset to the working project; filament_slot is 0-based.

Explicit flow_mode selects standard/high_flow values where supported.
Installed and canonical presets are never changed.
tools.name: select_preset

tools.description:
Edit project settings and return a new 3MF revision; never edits global presets.

Pass the last sha256 to reject stale edits. Filament arrays retain their
slot count/order. Custom G-code requires allow_custom_gcode; external
post-processing scripts and transport credentials are unsupported.
tools.name: set_config

tools.description: Set/update a Z-band's layer height in mm, relative to the object; clear removes bands.
tools.name: set_height_range

tools.description: Generate adaptive layers (quality 0=finer..1=coarser); reset clears profiles and Z bands.
tools.name: set_layer_height

tools.description: Edit object/part overrides. extruder=0 inherits; 1..N selects a filament slot.
tools.name: set_object_config

tools.description:
Slice the saved 3MF using the bound official native engine. 0=all plates.

Returns G-code paths/hashes, original source, settings and inspection
resource URIs. force bypasses verified cache. allow_newer_file explicitly
bypasses the native legacy producer-version gate and is recorded in the
result/cache identity; disable it for strict version checking.
No GUI or printer access.
tools.name: slice_3mf

tools.description: Slice the current working revision; omitted plate uses the selected plate, 0=all.
tools.name: slice_project

tools.description:
Apply XYZ translation deltas in mm, rotation deltas in degrees and scale factors.

Rotation/scaling preserve the instance pivot. Omit instance_id to edit
every instance of the object. Original component meshes remain intact.
tools.name: transform_object
